nameEn: Installation of industrial machinery and equipment
description: This class includes the specialised installation of industrial machinery and equipment in industrial plants.
includes: installation of industrial machinery in industrial plant: boilers, engines, turbines
installation of industrial process control equipment
installation of other industrial equipment: conveyor systems, overhead cranes
excludes: installation of electrical wiring and fixtures, see 4321
construction of foundations for machinery, see 4290
installation of heating, ventilation, air conditioning equipment, see 4322
installation of lifts/escalators as part of building construction, see 4329
